composite.definition: equal-weight mean of the signed within-strategy percentiles of the supported features

reading: A feature is supported only with a development interval that excludes zero, a Bonferroni-level development correlation and the same sign out of sample. Absence of support is not evidence of absence: the window is two weeks and neighbouring days share a regime.
